findings.title: TypeScript build broken - noEmit conflict
findings.description: tsconfig.json has 'allowImportingTsExtensions: true' but 'noEmit: false'. Package.json build script uses 'tsc --noEmit'. Results in 'dist/' missing most engine modules (only core/gameplay/subsystems present). Self-tests fail with ERR_UNSUPPORTED_DIR_IMPORT for mount, animation, physics, etc.
findings.proposedFix: Either set 'noEmit: true' in tsconfig.json and add separate compile step, OR remove 'allowImportingTsExtensions' and use proper ESM imports without .ts extensions in source files.

findings.title: Most self-tests cannot run due to broken build
findings.description: 67 self-test scripts exist but import from '../dist/engine/...' which is incomplete. Only engine-core-self-test.mjs passes (92/92). Other tests fail with module resolution errors.
findings.proposedFix: Fix TypeScript build to output all modules to dist/, then re-run test:all

findings.title: No unit test framework or coverage
findings.description: Project uses custom Node.js self-test scripts instead of Vitest/Jest. No code coverage reporting. No watch mode. No parallel execution. No snapshot testing.
findings.proposedFix: Add Vitest with coverage (v8 provider), configure test:unit and test:coverage scripts, migrate self-tests to Vitest

findings.title: TransformControls initialization order in EngineFacade
findings.description: TransformControls created at line 196 in EngineFacade, but avatarInstance created at line 170. Avatar is passed to BuildComponentPlacementController at line 185-193 which uses transformControls. TransformControls created AFTER buildComponentPlacement but BEFORE it's passed to controller - potential issue if controller accesses it during construction.
findings.proposedFix: Move TransformControls creation before BuildComponentPlacementController, or ensure controller doesn't access transformControls in constructor.

findings.title: Editor workspace references 'Montaria' in UI text
findings.description: PlayerWorkspace.vue line 378 contains Portuguese text 'pacote Montaria' in help text. While 'Montaria' is generic (means 'mount'), it's a game-specific term in UI rather than configurable label.
findings.proposedFix: Replace with generic term like 'pacote de montaria' or make it configurable via behavior package config.

findings.title: Potential event listener leaks in editor on unmount
findings.description: useEditor.ts onBeforeUnmount cleans up 'offs' array and keydown listener, but doesn't explicitly clean up: environmentSyncTimer (setInterval), some engine event listeners may not be in 'offs', viewport invalidate listeners added in EngineFacade.startViewport() may not be cleaned up.
findings.proposedFix: Track all timers/intervals in 'offs' array, ensure EngineFacade.dispose() cleans up all viewport invalidation listeners (already has viewportInvalidationOffs array).

findings.title: EngineCore supports multiple instances but editor assumes single
findings.description: EngineCore designed for multiple instances (parentContainer, parentEvents options). Editor useEditor.ts creates single Engine instance. No issues found but worth documenting.
findings.proposedFix: Document single-engine assumption in editor, or add support for multiple engines if needed for multi-viewport editing.

findings.title: Playwright E2E tests limited scope
findings.description: Only 2 test files: editor-runtime-hud.spec.ts (5 tests) and screenshots.spec.ts (1 test capturing 15 screenshots). No tests for: object manipulation, behavior packages, visual scripting, model import, terrain editing, project save/load.
findings.proposedFix: Expand E2E test coverage to critical user flows: create object → add behavior → enter runtime → verify behavior → exit runtime → save project.

findings.title: Generic gameplay systems well-separated from game-specific code
findings.description: Verified: the engine repository contains no game-specific implementation. EngineCore, EngineFacade, EngineConfig, EventBus, and DIContainer remain generic. Mounting, combat, behavior trees, inventory, navigation, and physics are reusable engine frameworks.
findings.proposedFix: No action needed - separation is clean.
